CustomField.description: Automatically identifies missing information requiring operational review.
CustomField.formula: IF( ISBLANK(Employer__c), "Missing employer. ", "" ) & IF( ISBLANK(TEXT(Job_Source__c)), "Missing job source. ", "" ) & IF( AND( ISPICKVAL(Stage__c, "Applied"), ISBLANK(Applied_Date__c) ), "Missing applied date. ", "" ) & IF( AND( OR( ISPICKVAL(Stage__c, "Recruiter Screening"), ISPICKVAL(Stage__c, "Interviewing"), ISPICKVAL(Stage__c, "Offer") ), ISBLANK(Primary_Recruiter__c) ), "Missing primary contact. ", "" ) & IF( AND( OR( ISPICKVAL(Stage__c, "Applied"), ISPICKVAL(Stage__c, "Recruiter Screening"), ISPICKVAL(Stage__c, "Interviewing"), ISPICKVAL(Stage__c, "Offer") ), ISBLANK(Next_Follow_Up_Date__c) ), "Missing next follow-up date. ", "" )
CustomField.label: Data Quality Issues
